outputs.overall_rationale: Aisha confuses Service Cloud with Sales Cloud, claims Marketing Cloud launched 'last year' (it's been around over a decade), and treats champion presence as sufficient to send a proposal. Objection handling is to discount; discovery is closed and pitch-driven. This is a fail on every dimension and should not advance to live calls without significant remediation.

product_knowledge_accuracy.evidence_quote: Sales Cloud is Salesforce's main product — it does everything: pipeline, customer service, marketing. Service Cloud is basically a newer name for Sales Cloud.
product_knowledge_accuracy.rationale: Conflates Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, claims Marketing Cloud is brand new, and treats every cloud as interchangeable.
product_knowledge_accuracy.gap_to_close: Cannot distinguish core products at the schema or business-outcome level — fundamental gap.
product_knowledge_accuracy.coaching_action: Targeted product modules for every cloud; do not advance until product fundamentals are solid.
product_knowledge_accuracy.label: Product knowledge accuracy

objection_handling.evidence_quote: If a prospect raises a price objection I would offer a 10% discount to get the deal closed faster.
objection_handling.rationale: Skips Defuse and Discover entirely; goes straight to discount as the lever, which trains the prospect to wait for the next discount.
objection_handling.gap_to_close: Inverts the rubric — discount is the wrong tool and undermines value-based positioning.
objection_handling.coaching_action: Re-do the objection roleplay program from the start; supervised practice with the SDR manager.
objection_handling.label: Objection handling (Defuse, Discover, Deliver)

meddic_application.evidence_quote: The Director is interested and engaged. They asked for a proposal. That means it's qualified.
meddic_application.rationale: Sends proposals to deals with no EB, no quantified pain, no decision process — exactly the pattern that produces failed AE handoffs.
meddic_application.gap_to_close: Champion-equals-qualified is the most common new-SDR mistake and is fully present here.
meddic_application.coaching_action: Mandatory MEDDIC qualification drills with weekly check-ins until consistent.
meddic_application.label: MEDDIC framework application

salesforce_value_messaging.evidence_quote: Sales Cloud has amazing features — AI-powered everything, automated workflows, mobile apps, and integration with thousands of other tools.
salesforce_value_messaging.rationale: Pure feature dump with no quantified outcome and no tie to the prospect's stated priorities.
salesforce_value_messaging.gap_to_close: Cannot articulate value beyond 'best CRM, Fortune 500 uses it.'
salesforce_value_messaging.coaching_action: Value messaging practice from the ground up; would benefit from shadowing a senior SDR on three live calls before next certification attempt.
salesforce_value_messaging.label: Salesforce value messaging

discovery_and_questioning.evidence_quote: Are you looking for a new CRM? What's wrong with your current CRM? How big is your sales team? What's your budget?
discovery_and_questioning.rationale: Four of five questions are closed yes/no or about Salesforce rather than the prospect's situation.
discovery_and_questioning.coaching_action: Discovery question bank practice with daily roleplays for two weeks.
discovery_and_questioning.label: Discovery and questioning

review_reasons: server-computed overall recommendation is FAIL — trainer review required

sources.passage: Passing bar: an SDR should score 7 or above on every dimension. A score of 5-6 on any one dimension is a borderline result and requires trainer review. A score of 4 or below on any dimension is a fail on that dimension regardless of the others.
MEDDIC framework application — Common gap: SDRs conflate a helpful contact with the economic buyer, and book meetings that the AE later rejects. Coaching action: MEDDIC qualification drills.
Q3 — MEDDIC framework application. Identify which elements are captured and which are missing. Would you call this a qualified opportunity ready for an AE handoff, or not?
